Considered but REJECTED a non-protected workaround for finding (0): bumping Playwright in package.json so --with-deps recognises ubuntu26.04. Rejected because (a) I could not verify any released Playwright supports 26.04 from this sandbox (no network/file-write approval in the autonomous run), and (b) package.json changes AUTO-MERGE once `npm test` passes, but the suite never exercises Playwright install — so an unverified dep bump that does NOT actually fix 26.04 (or regresses) would merge unattended. A known-broken screenshot step beats a wrong fix merged blind. The deterministic, reviewable fix is pinning the runner (FIX 0 below), which only a human may author.

Ruled out as cause (independently verified this run): tests (npm test — 1546 pass, 88 files), validation (node scripts/validate-events.js — 135 events, 0 errors; warnings only: 53 landing-page-only channel URLs, 4 weak time-basis, 2 weak channel-basis, 2 summary/streaming mismatches on alpine — all agent/content concerns, not machine breakage), publish freshness (publish-freshness.json 'fresh', lag 0h, live==repo 2026-11-02T10:23:25Z), and quota (usage-state.json green: week 1%, skipAll=false, allowed). So all three failures are real workflow breakage, not quota/transient/data noise.

OWNER FIX 0 (NEW, now the top priority — breaks both screenshot agents as ubuntu-latest completes its 24.04->26.04 rollout): pin `runs-on: ubuntu-latest` to `runs-on: ubuntu-24.04` on the visual-qa job (.github/workflows/visual-qa-agent.yml line 14) AND the ui-fix job (.github/workflows/ui-fix-agent.yml line 22). 24.04 is a current GitHub-hosted label and is the newest Ubuntu the pinned Playwright 1.58 supports (its nativeDeps stop at ubuntu24.04). This is the deterministic standard fix — upgrading Playwright to chase a brand-new OS is more fragile and, per note above, cannot be verified/auto-merged safely. Only these two workflows run `npx playwright install --with-deps` (grep-confirmed); no other job needs the pin. No test asserts runs-on (tests/workflows.test.js checks file references only), so the pin is test-safe.

OWNER FIX 1 (.github/workflows/research-agent.yml) — revives the escalation fast lane: add `allowed_bots: "*"` (or `"github-actions"`) under `with:` on all THREE anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 steps (standard Opus ~line 79, deep Fable ~102, deep Opus fallback ~130). The only bot that dispatches this workflow is github-actions, and workflow_dispatch already requires write access, so this does not widen who can run the agent. Tracked by open issue #430 (did NOT pile on another comment — already open and loud).

OWNER FIX 2 (.github/workflows/visual-qa-agent.yml): raise `--max-turns 40` to `--max-turns 60` in the single claude-code-action step. A failing run reported success at 54 turns, so 40 is below the task's real need; timeout-minutes gives wall-clock headroom, so the turn budget is the binding constraint.
